name: com.qa.loadtimekit
description: Measures cold-boot load time on device for QA/staging builds of any game: process start, splash, every scene load/unload, until the game marks Ready (Home or Gameplay usable). Writes one RESULT line plus a timeline to its own logcat tag (LoadTimeKit) and one JSON line per launch to a file on the device. No game references, no dependencies. Compiled out when PRODUCTION or QAKIT_DISABLED is defined.
